name: EDIT v5 gate diagnostic
description: Alternative to editlights6, active editor page 6 only. Classifies v5 first-three-byte singleton guard, manager flag/id/type, cursor and count before adding LEDs. Sender B adds high C; A adds high D. Status: low C# empty frame, low D multiple bits, low D# no manager flag, low F invalid manager id, low G rejected type, low G# zero count, low A count above 8, low A# cursor above 127, high F# no chord delta in 0..23, low B at least one chord delta in range. Key labels follow the supplied hardware map, not inferred note numbers. OR-only first-three-byte writes, no input change or SD calls. Hardware validation pending.
